snippet.title: Check Please! - Wait Tables in a Cozy Medieval Realm - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run chaotic restaurants in this fantasy medieval realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011450/Check_Please/
